weather_report:
In Boston, today presents a scene wrapped in a shroud of gray, the clouds heavy with intention, promising rain that will soon drench the city. The air, thick and moist, feels alive, stirring restlessly with east winds that whisper secrets of the impending downpour. As the day progresses, the temperature lingers just above brisk, encouraging one to bundle up a bit; a sturdy jacket, perhaps with an umbrella at the ready, would serve well against the relentless drizzle that looms ahead. 

With a 100% chance of rain tonight, expectations align with forecasts, suggesting a deep, unyielding grayness that dulls the brightness of typically vibrant autumn colors. Now might be a perfect moment for quiet indoor pursuits—perhaps an afternoon spent tucked away in a cozy café, easing into the rhythm of a good book or engaging in thoughtful conversation with friends amidst the soft patter of rain against the windows. Although outdoor escapades may feel uninviting, today is an invitation to savor the warmth and solace found within, as Boston dons its wet and exquisite palette of muted tones.
